description: The chart presents Shapley values for three models across a set of labeled categories, illustrating how the Shapley value varies by category and model. The horizontal axis contains the categories ordered left to right as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, and the vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80 (range shown from 0 up to about 80). Bars are grouped by category, with three adjacent bars per group corresponding to the legend in the upper right: mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in light green. Approximate bar heights by category are: L₄⁺ shows mBERT around 5, XLM-R around 6, and chLSTM near 0; L₃ shows mBERT near 0, XLM-R around 2, and chLSTM near 0; L₂ shows mBERT around 4, XLM-R around 5, and chLSTM around 1; L₁ shows mBERT around 13, XLM-R around 14, and chLSTM around 13; T contains the tallest bars with mBERT around 59, XLM-R around 54, and chLSTM around 79; R₁ shows mBERT around 10, XLM-R around 11, and chLSTM around 9; R₂ shows mBERT around 2, XLM-R around 3, and chLSTM slightly below 0; R₃ shows mBERT near 0, XLM-R around 1, and chLSTM slightly below 0; and R₄⁺ shows mBERT around 5, XLM-R around 5, and chLSTM slightly below 0. The bars are not visually sorted by height, and there are no special annotations or emphasis beyond the color legend and standard gridlines.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for different models across various categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories labeled as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, T, R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4^+, while the vertical axis represents the 'Shapley value,' measured on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick intervals of 20 units. Bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars representing different models: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green). The tallest bars appear in category T, where mBERT has an approximate value of 50, XLM-R about 70, and chLSTM reaching the maximum value of 80. In other categories such as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4^+, the bars are all relatively short, generally below 15. Notably, the values for R_1 consistently exceed those for L_1 across all models, indicating a stronger contribution from the right context. A legend is provided in the top right corner.
